runs.name: RWE AG; Frankfurt-listed, US Level 1 ADR RWEOY at one ADR per share, no SEC filings; Essen, Germany; electricity generation in five segments (Offshore Wind, Onshore Wind/Solar, Flexible Generation, Supply & Trading, Phaseout Technologies), with 25.1% of Amprion and 15% of E.ON; RWE Clean Energy renamed RWE Americas 2026-03-01; 36,143,952 new shares issued and all treasury shares sold at EUR 54.00 on 2026-06-22 to finance the Amprion transaction
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief; the brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25, the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's equivalents of Items 1, 1A and 7, the rivals taken from the annual report, and the no-SEC paragraph (the company's own annual report as primary document, the ECB 30-year for the euro). Price **EUR 55.62** (Xetra close 2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged; ADR USD 62.39 consistent at EUR/USD 1.122) x **779,985,169 shares** (743,841,217 issued at 2025-12-31 plus 36,143,952 issued 2026-06-22, no treasury after the sale of 38,240,169 treasury shares; Annual Report 2025 note 20 and Interim Report H1 2026) = cap **EUR 43,383M**; sovereign **3.62%** (ECB 30-year, 2026-10-23). Read from the Annual Report 2025 (12 March 2026, IR site PDF), the annual reports 2016 to 2020 and 2022 to 2024 (2021 not served; its figures from later comparatives), the Interim Report H1 2026, the Remuneration Report 2024 and the 2025 pay system. **Q1 IN, narrowly** (the doubt on the gas fleet's earnings in 2035 written down and carried). **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part is Flexible Generation (gas, hydro, biomass), 38% of five-year adjusted EBIT and the largest in 2025 alone; three grounds from the filings: a price-taker in markets of free price formation (risk report), contracted income won on the low bid (UK capacity auction cleared at GBP 60 per kW; German offshore support to the lowest bids), and ordinary returns over the cycle (segment adjusted EBIT EUR 418M, 2,005M, 2,695M, 1,464M, 973M in 2021 to 2025, a EUR 654M Dutch gas-fleet write-down in 2024). Peers: the annual report names no competitor; counterparties read from their own reports, both flagged as not SEC filers: Vattenfall ROCE 22.2%, 4.2%, 5.3%, 12.4%, 8.9% (2021 to 2025) against its own 8% over a cycle; Uniper more than 99% state-owned after its 2022 rescue; TotalEnergies and Equinor (SEC filers) named as partners, not read. Facts found after the stop, not weighed: guidance featured on adjusted figures; the short-term bonus on adjusted EBIT with no capital charge; the CEO pay cap raised from EUR 9.3M to EUR 11.0M; buyback with no stated price at an average EUR 38.52, the shares resold at EUR 54.00; equity EUR 8.0bn to 41.6bn over 2016 to 2025 largely from new capital, shares up about 27%; recurring impairments outside adjusted EBIT (EUR 1,359M in 2024, 729M in 2025); ten-year income before tax about 4% a year on equity plus net debt. Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after all spending EUR -2,564M a year 2021 to 2025 (negative in four of five years); maintenance case (depreciation as the guess, confessed; no split disclosed) EUR 2,965M all-equity, 2,750M equity-only; range **EUR 63.74 to 91.19 a share all-equity (central; merchant generation, not a regulated utility)**, equity-only EUR 66.93 to 97.41; no case earns the floor at the price (best 5.5%); fair price **EUR 4.79 all-equity**, EUR 15.44 equity-only. Framework gaps for the operator: which governs when Q2's commodity paragraph (cost position unreadable, TOO HARD) and the OUT items (price-taker, low bid, ordinary returns) both apply; whether the parts convention should check the largest part in the latest year when the five-year window straddles a crisis; whether depreciation may stand in for maintenance under specific (e) when the filing gives no split. Could not get: the 2021 annual report PDF, the Remuneration Report 2025, any fleet cost per MWh against rivals, capitalised interest 2021 to 2023 (taken as nil, flattering the top of the range). Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; pathspec commits, own paths only (last `4ad62f8a`); 37 ids resolve, no E-ids, no citation slip, 21 adjacent fragment pairs checked (`dispatcher_cite_check.py`); no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: session-start commit subjects of the PEG run, a research folder name (ARCB), a memory index line, and one listing of `Test Runs/` filtered for "rwe" that returned nothing; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2: the deciding part, Flexible Generation (gas, hydro, biomass), takes its price from the market, wins its contracted income on the low bid, and earned ordinary returns over the cycle; the renewables parts earn about the return they bid at auction. Computation only: all-equity range EUR 63.74 to 91.19 vs EUR 55.62 at the 3.62% ECB rate, no case earns the floor (best 5.5%), fair EUR 4.79 all-equity.
